description: This file defines API endpoints for authentication, including login and signup, using FastAPI. It handles user credential validation, token generation, and user creation in the database.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Database model representing a user, used for querying and creating user data.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Schema for login request payload containing email and password.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Schema for JWT token response containing access token and expiration information.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Schema for new user registration data.

classes.name: UserOut
classes.description: Schema for user data output to clients.

methods.name: Token login(data: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns a JWT token.

methods.name: UserOut signup(data: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new user account and returns user info.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(data: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> Token:$/

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^def signup(data: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> UserOut:$/
